what_to_detect: On the turn a Saga with read ahead enters, the chapter trigger whose number equals its lore counters fires.
near_miss: On that turn, a lower chapter's trigger does not fire although its lore threshold is passed.
record_fields: trigger record payload.fired on a Chapter keyword line
card lines (gen-3) holding a Read ahead keyword line
note: Forge builds read ahead from a Moved replacement and a DisableTriggers static, never a trigger, so trigger_mode keyword Read ahead would match nothing; a disabled chapter trigger may also leave no trigger record at all.
